custom_logic_notes: The EA uses the standard MQL5 Expert Advisor framework (CExpert, CExpertSignal) with a voting system. The CBH_BH_MFI filter casts a weighted vote (0-100 scale). If the absolute weighted vote >= Signal_ThresholdOpen (40), a trade is opened. If the absolute weighted vote >= Signal_ThresholdClose (20) in the opposite direction, the position is closed. The actual MFI/MA crossover logic is encapsulated inside CBH_BH_MFI class in the external .mqh file. Expert_EveryTick=false means signal is evaluated once per bar, not every tick. PriceLevel=0 means market execution at current price. StopLevel=0 and TakeLevel=0 mean no fixed SL/TP - exits are purely signal-driven.
